# AviQR

> QR-powered digital menu, live order management, and multilingual restaurant/hotel/mall operating system for India. Customers scan a QR code with their phone camera — no app to install — to view the menu, order, pay, and track order status live. Businesses manage the whole operation (menu, kitchen display, inventory, staff, loyalty, analytics) from one dashboard.

AviQR is built for restaurants, cafes, hotels, and shopping malls/food courts in India. The Starter plan is free with no credit card required.

## What it does

- Permanent QR code per shop/table — scan opens the live menu in the browser, no app install, no reprinting when prices change.
- Menu supports 9 Indian languages (Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Bengali, Marathi, Gujarati, Malayalam, English), selectable by the customer on the menu itself.
- OCR menu upload: photograph a printed menu and AI builds the structured digital menu (items, prices, categories) in minutes.
- Online ordering and payment (Razorpay: UPI, card, cash, wallet), with live order status tracking (Confirmed → Preparing → Ready → Served) and a pickup/order code.
- Kitchen Display (KOT), GST-ready POS billing, inventory and recipe cost tracking, staff roles (owner/manager/kitchen/cashier), loyalty and CRM with tiers, SMS campaigns, dynamic time/date-based pricing, and analytics/reporting.
- 11 AI features: admin assistant, recommendations, smart menu search, support chatbot, AI analytics, description writer, review sentiment, fraud detection, demand forecasting, dynamic pricing, and voice ordering.
- Hotel mode: rooms, bookings, housekeeping/laundry/spa requests, and room-charge billing from an in-room QR.
- Mall/food-court mode: one QR for the whole court, vendor onboarding, and per-stall revenue-share tracking.
- Aggregator sync to Zomato and Swiggy, with stock-out items flipped off automatically from the POS.

## Pricing

- Starter — free, no credit card required, up to 20 menu items / 50 orders per day / 1 QR code.
- Growth — ₹999/month.
- Business — ₹2,499/month — adds multi-outlet dashboard, CRM & retention, AI recommendations, API access, priority support.
- No per-order commission on any plan — flat monthly subscription only.
